metrics.label: Latest funding

company: Vercel was founded in 2015 by Guillermo Rauch. It created Next.js, one of the most widely used web frameworks, and sells a cloud platform that deploys and scales web applications. Its v0 product uses AI to generate interfaces and apps.

In September 2025 Vercel raised a $300 million Series F led by Accel and GIC at a $9.3 billion valuation, up from $3.25 billion in May 2024. Annualized revenue was reported at about $340 million in February 2026, roughly double a year earlier.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Vercel sits where web development and AI-generated software meet, and its growth is a read-through for how AI changes the way apps are built and hosted.

takeaways: Next.js gives Vercel a large developer funnel.
AI app generation through v0 is a new growth driver.

Hosting depends on underlying cloud providers, which affects margins.
